featured_reviews.name: Ananya Bar
featured_reviews.review_text:
New Alpha Academy is a very good school for growing kids. We as a family were always worried for our son's first entry in school. But when we visited the school first time and met their director, Principal and all the Teachers, we were very much satisfied after talking to them. Further, while going through the school visit we were amazed and surprised the way they take care of our children in their learning. The atmosphere of the school is very good. Our son Johan Masih likes it very much. All the activities which were conducted offline were very good and the way kids were involved from all age groups whether it was sports or annual day or a outgoing trip, those were awesome. Online teaching at this age is very much encouraging and approaching to kids. They put all the skillful activities in online teaching and it is  successful and so interesting. We believe that not only our son but all the kids would have been benefitted by the hard work, dedication and love of the teachers.

Finally we would like to rate alpha academy teaching & learning 5/5 including the infrastructure facility. Hats off to all administration and all the loving teachers who have made our child's learning very good and made him feel at home. We are really grateful to God for giving such opportunity to our son's life to study in this school.
